page: Microsoft Azure E8nds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance deployed on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is configured with 8 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs powered by an Intel processor. Supporting these execution resources is 64.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a high compute-to-memory allocation of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. No discrete GPU accelerators are integrated into this configuration.

For low-latency temporary storage, the E8nds_v6 includes 472 GB of bundled local NVMe SSD capacity. It additionally provides Premium Storage capability for external persistent volume attachments. Network optimization is native to the Endv6 family design, although complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not provided by default.

From a resource-efficiency perspective, the high RAM-to-core ratio paired with fast local NVMe storage reduces external volume overhead for applications with demanding caching or intermediate storage requirements. This architecture aligns effectively with memory-intensive workloads, including relational database management systems, in-memory caches, analytics engines, and transactional enterprise backends.
